from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper found by the parser, including its title and the papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection cited by this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperReference]
